no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not presented at an advisory committee.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for EDARBI (azilsartan medoxomil, NDA200796). The Summary Review states the application was not presented at an advisory committee, and both the Approval letter and OtherR review explain the drug was not referred to an AC because it is not first in its class, its safety profile is similar to other approved drugs in the class, and it raised no controversial issues requiring outside expertise. Because no committee met, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
